rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Inkog is an AI security platform that scans AI agents and MCP servers for vulnerabilities before deployment. It detects security flaws like prompt injection, token bombing, infinite recursion, and data leakage risks. The platform supports compliance reporting aligned with EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and OWASP LLM Top 10 standards. Works across 15+ frameworks including LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, PydanticAI, n8n, and Flowise.
